senses.gloss:
धुर् धुर्, ऊर्, f. (fr. rt. धृ?, in Mahā-bh.
Anuśāsana-p. 2876. धुर् is masc.), that part of a
yoke which rests on the shoulder; a yoke; a bur-
den, load (literally and metaphorically); the peg or
pin at both ends of an axle for fastening the nave
of the wheel; the foremost part of the pole, where
the yoke is fixed; the pole itself, the shaft, the fore-
most or highest place, the top, the place of honour;
a finger; N. of six verses of the Bahish-pavamāna
which are to be sung in a peculiar manner; (some
lexicographers add the following meanings) agitation,
trembling; reflection, recollection; a spark of fire; a
part, a portion; wealth; a N. of the Ganges; धुरि,
ind. at the head of, = अग्रे; [cf. धूर्, दुर्-धुर्,
दृढ-धुर्.]
—धुरन्-धर, अस्, ई, अम्, bear-
ing the yoke, bearing a burden, fit to be harnessed;
bearing a burden with patience, (figuratively) laden
with good qualities or with weighty duties, &c.; (अस्),
m. a beast of burden; a man of business; a chief,
leader; an epithet of Śiva; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people; N. of a Rakṣas; the tree Grislea Tomen-
tosa.
—धुर्-गत, धुर्-वह, धुर्-वोढृ, incor-
rect forms for धूर्-गत, धूर्-वह, धूर्-वोढृ;
see under 2. धूर्, p. 458, col. 2.

धूर् 2. धूर् for धुर् (q. v.) at the begin-
ning of a comp.
—धूर्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, standing
on or going along the pole or fore-part of a chariot;
standing at the head, taking the first place, preceding,
foremost.
—धूर्-जटि, इस्, m., in one place also धूर्-
जटिन्, ई, m. (fr. धुर् and जटि = जटा), ‘whose matted
locks are like a burden,’ an epithet of Rudra-Śiva;
N. of a medical author.
—धूर्-धर, अस्, आ, अम्,
bearing a load or burden, managing affairs; (अस्),
m. a beast of burden; [cf. धुरन्-धर.]
—धूर्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a load, laden.
—धूर्-वह,
अस्, आ, अम्, bearing a load, carrying a burden;
managing affairs; (अस्), m. a beast of burden.
—धूर्-वोढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, bearing a load,
the carrier of a burden.
—धूर्-षद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved.
standing under the yoke, drawing a load; resting on
the yoke; moving, promoting.
—धूर्-षाह्, ट्, ट्,
ट्, Ved. bearing the yoke.

धुर, अस्, m. at end of comp. = धुर्, a yoke,
pole; burden; pin at the end of an axle &c.; (1.
धुरा), f. a burden, load.
—धुरा-वह, अस्, आ,
अम्, bearing a burden (= धूर्-वह).

धुरा 2. धुरा, ind. (for 1. see धुर, p. 456,
col. 3), violently, hurtfully, (perhaps fr. rt. धुर्व् or
धूर्व्.)

धुरीण, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be harnessed; bearing
a burden or able to bear one, laden with, abounding
with (qualities, duties, &c.); (अस्), m. a beast of
burden; a man of business; a leader, chief; [cf.
उत्तर-ध्˚, एक-ध्˚, दक्षिण-ध्˚, सर्व-ध्˚.]

धुरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, able to bear a burden, fit
[]
for a load, suited to a burden; charged with important
duties; (अस्), m. a beast of burden; a man of business
or one entrusted with weighty affairs.

धुर्य or (sometimes wrongly spelt) धूर्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be harnessed, fit for a burden, able
to bear one, &c.; standing at the head, holding the
first place, foremost, best; a leader; (अस्), m. a
beast of burden, a horse or bullock attached to the
shaft, shafter; a leader, chief (e. g. कुल-धुर्य, the
chief or leader of a family); a minister, a chargé
d'affaires; a kind of medicinal plant, = ऋषभ;
(अम्), n. the fore-part of the pole.
धूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, for धुर्य, q. v.

धुर्व् धुर्व् [cf. rt. धूर्व्], cl. 1. P. धुर्-
वति, &c., to hurt, kill.

धूर्व् धूर्व् (connected with rts. धुर्व्,
ध्वृ, धूर्, ह्वृ), cl. 1. P. धूर्वति, दु-
धूर्व, धूर्विष्यति, अधूर्वीत्, धूर्वितुम्, Ved.
to bend, cause to fall, hurt, injure: Desid. दुधूर्-
षति, to wish to hurt.
धूर्ण धूर्ण = धूण = धूनक.
धूर्त धूर्त. See under rt. धूर्व् below.

धूर्त, अस्, आ, अम्, cunning, crafty, dishonest,
knavish, fraudulent, subtle; mischievous, injurious;
(अस्), m. a rogue, cheat, swindler; a gamester; (in
amatory language) a gay deceiver, a lover or
gallant; the thorn-apple, Datura [cf. कितव and
क्रूर-धूर्त]; a kind of perfume [cf. चोरक];
(आ), f. a sort of nightshade; (अम्), n. rust
or iron-filings; black salt (= खण्ड-लवण;
cf. क्षेम-धूर्त).
—धूर्त-कितव, अस्, m. a
gamester.
—धूर्त-कृत्, त्, m. = धूर्त, dishonest,
a knave, rogue, cheat; (त्), m. thorn-apple.
—धूर्त-
चरित, अम्, n. ‘the actions of rogues,’ N. of a
work.
—धूर्त-जन्तु, उस्, m. ‘the cunning creature,’
man.
—धूर्त-ता, f. or धूर्त-त्व, अम्, n. knavery,
craftiness, roguery, knavishness, shrewdness.
—धूर्-
त-त्रय, अम्, n. three rogues, a trio of swindlers.
—धूर्त-नर्तक, अम्, n. ‘rogues as actors,’ N.
of a comedy by Sāma-rāja.
—धूर्त-प्रलाप, अस्,
m. the talk or confabulation of rogues.
—धूर्त-
मण्डल, अस्, m. a party of rogues or gamblers.
—धूर्त-मानुषा, f., N. of a plant (= रास्ना).
—धूर्त-रचना, f. a cunning plot, roguery.
—धूर्त-राज, अस्, m. the chief of rogues.
—धूर्-
त-समागम, अम्, n. ‘assemblage of rogues,’ N. of
a comedy by Jyotir-īśvara.
—धूर्त-स्वामिन्, ई, m.
‘lord of the rogues,’ N. of a commentator on
Āpastamba.

धूर्तक, अस्, आ, अम्, cunning, a cheat, a rogue;
(अस्), m. a jackal; N. of a Nāga.
धूर्ति, इस्, f., Ved. injury, damage.
धूर्तिल in अक्ष-ध्˚, q. v.
धूर्वन्, अ, n., Ved. causing to fall, bending.
धूर्वा धूर्वा, f., Ved. = दूर्वा, q. v.

धूर्वी धूर्वी, f. the fore-part or pole of a
carriage, = धुर्, q. v.
